summary: Added a clean build-source ZIP creator and documented the supported two-PC packaging workflow.
details: The ZIP creator stages only required frontend and Python API build inputs, validates the archive, and writes ArcRho.zip with a SHA-256 sidecar.
Final archives, temporary staging data, and atomic replacement backups are isolated under E:\XWSpace\Build ArcRho App.
ZIP-creation and application-build logs from both PCs are centralized under per-computer folders in E:\XWSpace\Build ArcRho App\logs.
The build-PC log captures the complete local-workspace flow, including ZIP extraction and failures that occur before application packaging starts.
Archive creation uses a streamed .NET ZIP writer with visible file-count progress instead of the hanging Windows PowerShell Compress-Archive path.
Repository metadata, generated build outputs, caches, notebooks, and local logs are excluded from the build-source archive.
Local workspace troubleshooting logs are excluded from the generated repository file inventory.
